concept: Secrets Manager: automatic rotation of DB credentials
tests: Choosing a service to centrally store and automatically rotate DB passwords for many Lambdas with minimal effort.
expected: Secrets Manager with automatic rotation (rotation Lambda, built-in support for RDS and others). Triggers: "centrally manage and rotate database credentials", "minimal operational effort".
why_not: Parameter Store standard — no native rotation; Lambda env vars — static and insecure; KMS encrypts but does not store or rotate passwords.
